Scope Note

Issue request: "Move flow upload to background like Google Drive." QA scope was verified from current source architecture because the target behavior is an editor upload-flow implementation pattern: selected files should enter the editor immediately, uploads should continue in the background with visible progress, and save/publish should stay guarded until upload jobs finish.

2 Gray Upload progress and controls Queue tracks queued/uploading/done/error states, progress percentage, retry, dismiss, auto-clear, and visible editor indicator Pass

Area Actual result Review
Add artwork flow SubmitComponent closes the add-artwork dialog first, emits local artwork data for editor placement, then enqueues upload jobs through ArtworkUploadQueueService. Pass: user can continue editing while upload work runs in the background.
Object upload flow ObjectsComponent builds a local object, appends it to the editor list, loads it into the scene, then enqueues the real upload. Pass: object upload follows the same optimistic/background pattern.
